key_positions: Committed to becoming the first climate-neutral continent by 2050 through the European Green Deal.
Implement the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) to prevent carbon leakage.
Accelerate the transition to a circular economy and significantly increase energy efficiency.
red_lines: Will not compromise on the 2030 target of reducing net greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55%.
Refuses to delay the phase-out of fossil fuel subsidies.
